prompt:
Redraw the Highland Citadel target concept board using the provided references. One exquisite wide 16:9 stylized 3D game-art target image, inspired by Oskar Stålberg's readable Bad North / Townscaper masses and the SPECIFIC later tree/cloud studies shown. This is a concept, not an implemented screenshot.
Reference roles: image1 is the previous target to redesign; image2 is the ACTUAL game scene and controls placement and architectural identity; image3 is the cloud/vegetation visual reference; image4 is the forest/grass edge reference.
Retain LEFT densely built old town with tall slender masonry tower and terracotta domed crowns; RIGHT monumental stepped fortress with large teal dome, terraces and smaller terracotta domes; central rocky saddles and open gorge; bridge spanning the bay, foreground curving railway and old-town port access stairs/waterfall. Preserve circulation and readable foundations. Buildings must remain recognizable and fully visible. No European cottage replacement.
Major revision: make the vegetation, lighting and clouds actually read like images3/4 rather than the sparse individual bushes and glossy over-detailed rendering of image1.
PALETTE: broad quiet color fields, pale warm limestone facing the sun, desaturated blue-slate / blue-green shaded rock faces, muted yellow-sage grass, cooler rounded eucalyptus/sea-green canopy masses, small terracotta roof accents, grey-teal castle dome, dark muted teal sea. Soft unified directional daylight and ambient contact shadows; restrained saturation. No strong bloom, cyan oversaturation, bright white cliffs everywhere, noisy texture, yellow selection outlines or debug wireframe. Fine sparse softly colored contour accents only at real silhouette or material boundaries.
LAND: coherent thick main peaks, subsidiary ridges, usable broad shoulders and saddles, softened convex silhouettes but meaningful hard cliff breaks. Clearly bare steep cliffs. Not stacked cones, plates, green triangles or vertical grass.
VEGETATION: group overlapping rounded deciduous tree crowns into CONTINUOUS medium-sized forest patches, with quieter interior contours, readable outer scalloped silhouettes and softly shaded volume; vary density and height without uniform spheres or scattered confetti bushes. Forest covers suitable broad slopes and shelves, leaves winding pale green grass clearings. Retain a few dark green cypress accents near architecture but no spike rows. Every tree rooted and no masonry on foliage. Grass-rock margin is a fine irregular organic curve: turf core -> low groundcover/shrub fringe -> thin soil and scattered exposed stones -> bare rock; no large triangle cutouts. Larger connected grass regions, not only a sprinkle of bushes. Mountain backside should look as designed as front.
CLOUDS: a FEW distinct fluffy clustered cloud banks with warm white lit lobes and pale cool grey undersides, inspired directly by image3's tree-related rounded volumetric appearance. A rear valley cloud bank passes BEHIND middle ridges, additional distant bank by horizon; one small puff near rear shoulder for scale. Real readable occlusion and coherent light. Keep ALL domes, tall towers, main paths and main peak silhouette clear. No blanket haze, flat transparent circles, photorealistic storm clouds, or cloud-covered architecture.
WATER: calm broad teal field; sparse narrow broken pale foam crescents wrapping rock bases and bay edges, multiple uneven distances rather than fixed thick white neon rim. No excessive water glitter.
Board layout: Main wide panorama fills almost all canvas. Bottom right small elegant inset (around 24% canvas width) showing a CLOSE crop of the SAME mountain slope: joined forest crowns, pale grass clearing, irregular turf-to-rock fringe and cool shadow. Inset should demonstrate specific surface transition, not unrelated landscape. Top left Chinese title “高山圣城 · 目标图 V2”; inset label “林地—草坡—裸岩”; unobtrusive bottom caption “概念提案 · 非实机画面”. No extra text or charts.
Aim for a cohesive restrained GAME ART diorama, painterly normals, softly edged large shapes, strong overview legibility. Avoid photorealism, photographic miniature depth of field and ultra-detailed foliage.
scope: Concept only; no runtime changes. Layout and architectural identity based on real scene, image details are proposals.
review: Preserves left old city tower, right domed citadel, bridge, stairs and railway. Expanded connected rounded canopy patches with grass clearings and irregular bare-rock edge. Cloud masses behind ridges keep main architecture visible. Some summits remain greener than advisor's sparse-peak preference; implementation should constrain to soil-bearing shoulders.
